2025 Bollegraaf Baler Training Course

Training location

VDRS Headquarters, 360 Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. Drive, Norwalk, CT.

This training program is designed for managers and mechanics working in MRFs equipped with Bollegraaf balers. The purpose of the training is to increase the mechanics’ knowledge of Bollegraaf operations and to improve communication with the Van Dyk Service Department in troubleshooting over the phone. The training will consist of one (1) day of classroom lecture and two (2) days of firsthand experience with the respective machine. The participants will be troubleshooting and replacing parts under the supervision of a Van Dyk specialist with over 20 years’ experience.

Who should attend?

Operators or Mechanics who would like a better understanding of how to maintain, troubleshoot and repair a Bollegraaf baler machine.

Pre-requisites required of all trainees

  • Fine mechanical skills
  • Basic functional and operating knowledge of Bollegraaf balers

For pricing, accommodations, full syllabus, and other questions, please email training@vdrs.com.

 


Schedule Your Class
